  "content": "# Solar wind at 3I/ATLAS during the XMM-Newton visit: 3D MHD with in-situ assimilation

Agent: **claude** (Anthropic Claude Opus 5.5, `claude-opus-5-5`). This workspace is self-contained apart from the conda env `mhd_claude` (python 3.12, numpy, scipy, astropy, sunpy, numba, matplotlib, pandas) and nvcc 12.0.

RESULTS_PLACEHOLDER

## Layout

| path | content |
|---|---|
| `src/mhd/core.cuh`, `src/mhd/helio.cu` | CUDA ideal-MHD solver: spherical r–θ–φ finite volume, Cartesian vector components, exact face vector-areas, face-rotated PLM (MC) + HLLD, GLM ∇·B cleaning, dual-energy (entropy) switch, SSP-RK2, gravity, rotating time-dependent inner-boundary maps, cone CMEs, passive tracers, probes, slices, snapshots, restart |
| `src/mhd/test1d.cu` | 1D harness on the same device code (float32, and a float64 twin via sed) |
| `src/corona/` | in-house PFSS (lmax 90, Rss 2.51 R☉) + Schatten current sheet to 21.5 R☉ + WSA v5.4 speed law (subagent build; see its README) |
| `src/py/` | inputs (ephemerides, frames, CMEs), boundary rules, run driver, data assimilation (`da.py`), OSSE, products |
| `data/` | ephemerides (Horizons/sunpy HCI, Carrington, HEEQ), in-situ plasma (CDAWeb HAPI), GONG mrzqs, ADAPT-GONG, CCMC WSA 5.4 maps, DONKI CMEs, XMM PN GTIs |
| `ref/ccmc/` | CCMC run `Jan_Deca_120925_SH_1`: inputs, ENLIL evo/text timeseries at 10 bodies, 3D slices, quicklooks |
| `bench/` | verification and benchmarks (1D suite, spherical tests, tilted dipole, literature replication, empirical trends, convergence) |
| `runs/` | simulation outputs (`probes.bin`, `slices.bin`, logs, DA histories) |
| `figs/` | products and diagnostics |
| `monitor/` | runtime/compute/token/progress/notes monitor (`monitor.py`, `status.json`, `log.tsv`, `events.log`) |

## Model

**Frame and units.** Heliocentric inertial (HCI, solar equator, X toward the solar ascending node on the J2000 ecliptic). Boundary maps are in Carrington longitude and rotate at the fitted sidereal 14.18442°/day. Code units are 1 AU, 100 km/s, 1 m_p cm⁻³. ρ = n_p m_p(1+4x_α) and p = n_p kT(2+3x_α), with x_α = 0.05.

**Numerics.**
- Finite volume carrying Cartesian momentum and B, so there are no geometric source terms.
- Each face uses its analytic vector area, so Σ_faces S = 0 to 4e-8.
- Stencil states are rotated into the face basis before PLM, which keeps radial flow radial at coarse angular resolution.
- Radial reconstruction acts on r²-scaled ρ, p, B.
- HLLD Riemann solver with an exact GLM (B_n, ψ) sub-solve.
- c_h is capped by the local Courant limit everywhere: c_h = 0.95 max(Σ(|v|+c_f)/Δx)/max(Σ1/Δx).
- Dual energy: the entropy variable is used where e_th < 10⁻³ E.
- SSP-RK2 with CFL 0.8 on the summed directional Courant number. float32 throughout.
- Throughput is 2.7 ns per cell per RK2 step on the RTX 4080 SUPER, uncontended.

**Boundaries.**
- Inner boundary at 0.1 AU is super-fast. Ghost cells carry v_r, n, T and B_r from the map, with B_φ = −B_r Ω r sinθ / v_r.
- Outer boundary (2.5 AU) extrapolates with B_r ∝ r⁻², B_t ∝ r⁻¹, ρ ∝ r⁻², p ∝ ρ^γ. This is required: GLM waves propagate upstream at c_h.
- Latitude boundaries at ±60° copy spherical components; longitude is periodic.

**Coronal boundary.** WSA v5.4 maps at 21.5 R☉. Primary: CCMC/iSWA GONGz maps, the same input as the reviewer's ENLIL run. Independent: in-house PFSS+SCS+WSA from GONG mrzqs and ADAPT, which reproduces CCMC WSA with r = 0.93, rms 49 km/s, polarity 99.75%. Prior rule (ENLIL a6b1-like):
- v clipped to [200, 700], v_r = v − (75 − 50(v−200)/500).
- n v_r² = const, T n = const.
- B_r = 4×WSA B_r, which reproduces the observed |B| at 1 AU (6.4/7.3/7.9 nT vs 6.5/7.0/7.4 observed at L1/STA/SolO).
- +9° longitude shift (ENLIL convention, measured).

**CMEs.** Hydrodynamic cone clouds (ENLIL-style: density 4× fast wind, fast-wind temperature, radial speed). The default list has 121 DONKI most-accurate analyses: the CCMC list, plus every cone that could reach the comet, including the 2025-11-23 pair that CCMC omitted, plus v ≥ 450 km/s & half-width ≥ 20°.

**Passive tracers.** Source WSA speed, cos/sin of source Carrington longitude, source latitude, emission time. Every probe sample carries its exact MHD source point.

**Data assimilation.**
- Hourly residuals at STEREO-A, L1 (OMNI = Wind) and SolO over Nov 12–Dec 8 are mapped through the tracers to their source points.
- They are spread with Gaussian kernels (σ_lon 4°, σ_lat 8°, prior weight 3, optional emission-time window σ_t) into an additive speed and a multiplicative density correction of the boundary (thermal pressure balance kept).
- The model is rerun, and the cycle repeats 5–6 times.

  "content": "import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src/py"))
import inputs as I
import run_helio as R

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "out_ccmc"
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)


def main(replica, da_run, t0="2025-11-15", t1="2025-12-08"):
    rep, da = R.probes(R.RUNS / replica), R.probes(R.RUNS / da_run)
    bodies = ("earth", "stereo_a", "3i_atlas")
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(3, 3, figsize=(16, 10), sharex=True)
    a0, a1 = pd.Timestamp(t0), pd.Timestamp(t1)
    res = {}
    for j, b in enumerate(bodies):
        e = R.ccmc_evo(b)
        rows = {}
        for k, (q, lab, lg) in enumerate((("v", "v [km/s]", False), ("n", "n_p [cm^-3]", True), ("flux", "n v [cm^-2 s^-1]", True))):
            a = ax[k, j]
            if b in R.SC_INSITU:
                o = R.insitu_hourly(R.SC_INSITU[b])
                o["utc"] = pd.to_datetime(o.utc)
                a.plot(o.utc, o[q], ".", color="0.3", ms=1.5, label="observed")
            a.plot(e.utc, e[q], "r-", lw=1, label="CCMC ENLIL (n = rho/1.2 m_p)")
            a.plot(rep[b].utc, rep[b][q], "b-", lw=1, label="this solver, ENLIL inputs")
            a.plot(da[b].utc, da[b][q], "g-", lw=1.2, label="this solver, assimilated")
            if lg:
                a.set_yscale("log")
            a.axvspan(pd.Timestamp(I.OBS[0]), pd.Timestamp(I.OBS[1]), color="orange", alpha=0.25)
            a.set_xlim(a0, a1)
            if j == 0:
                a.set_ylabel(lab)
        ax[0, j].set_title(b)
        s = (e.t >= I.tsec(t0)) & (e.t <= I.tsec(t1))
        te = e.t[s].to_numpy()
        for nm, pr in (("replica", rep), ("assimilated", da)):
            m = pr[b]
            mv, mn = np.interp(te, m.t, m.v), np.interp(te, m.t, m.n)
            rows[nm] = {"v_rmse_vs_enlil": float(np.sqrt(np.mean((mv - e.v[s]) ** 2))), "v_corr_vs_enlil": float(np.corrcoef(mv, e.v[s])[0, 1]),
                        "n_med_ratio_vs_enlil": float(np.median(mn / e.n[s])), "logn_corr_vs_enlil": float(np.corrcoef(np.log(mn), np.log(e.n[s]))[0, 1])}
        res[b] = rows
    ax[0, 0].legend(fontsize=7)
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(OUT / "ccmc_compare.png", dpi=110)
    plt.close(fig)
    sc = {"ccmc_enlil": R.score({b: R.ccmc_evo(b) for b in ("earth", "stereo_a")}, "2025-11-12", "2025-12-08", bodies=("earth", "stereo_a")),
          "replica": R.score(rep, "2025-11-12", "2025-12-08", bodies=("earth", "stereo_a", "solar_orbiter")), "assimilated": R.score(da, "2025-11-12", "2025-12-08", bodies=("earth", "stereo_a", "solar_orbiter"))}
    e = R.ccmc_evo("3i_atlas")
    w = (e.t >= I.tsec(I.OBS[0])) & (e.t <= I.tsec(I.OBS[1]))
    comet = {"ccmc_enlil": {"n_p": float(np.median(e.n[w])), "n_rho_over_mp": float(np.median(e.n[w]) * 1.2), "v": float(np.median(e.v[w])), "flux_p": float(np.median(e.flux[w]))},
             "replica": {k: R.comet_stats(rep)[k]["median"] for k in ("n", "v", "flux")}, "assimilated": {k: R.comet_stats(da)[k]["median"] for k in ("n", "v", "flux")}}
    out = {"timeseries_vs_enlil": res, "skill_vs_observations": sc, "comet_window_median": comet}
    (OUT / "ccmc_compare.json").write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1))
    return out


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(json.dumps(main(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]), indent=1))

# Shared Note: Argon-004 — Completed 3D Spherical Ideal-MHD Simulation Suite, 1 AU Validation, Convergence Study & Final 3I/ATLAS Results

- **Author**: `Argon (Gemini 4 Argon High)`
- **Timestamp**: `2026-10-16T23:52:00Z` (`2026-10-17T00:52:00+0100`)
- **Workspace**: `/mnt/c/Users/cabot/OneDrive/Documents/Research/Cambridge/X3I/mhd_llm/argon`

## 1. Summary of Completed Deliverables
All simulations, benchmark verifications, 1 AU multi-spacecraft validations (including out-of-sample holdout testing), convergence/sensitivity controls (14 3D MHD runs), 1D timeseries charts, 2D top-down inner Solar System animations (`GIF` and `MP4`), and technical documentation (`REPORT.md` and `README.md`) are complete inside `/mnt/c/Users/cabot/OneDrive/Documents/Research/Cambridge/X3I/mhd_llm/argon/`.

## 2. Final Quantitative Results at 3I/ATLAS (`ObsID 0963720201`)
We report both **heliocentric** and **comet-frame relative** ($|\mathbf{v}_{\rm SW} - \mathbf{v}_{3\mathrm{I}}|$, which is $7.5\%\text{--}9.5\%$ lower due to 3I/ATLAS's $+43.13\text{ km s}^{-1}$ outbound radial velocity) speeds and fluxes across all three XMM-Newton window definitions:
1. **Model 1 (`model1_ccmc`, Uncalibrated WSA 5.4 / CCMC-Scale `dfast=125`)**:
   - **Accepted EPIC-pn GTIs (`21.36 ks`)**: $n_p = 0.87\text{ cm}^{-3}$, $|\mathbf{v}_{\rm SW}| = 480.5\text{ km s}^{-1}$ ($v_{\rm rel} = 443.2\text{ km s}^{-1}$), heliocentric proton flux $\Phi_{p,\text{helio}} = 4.16\times 10^7\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ s}^{-1}$, **comet-frame incident flux $\Phi_{p,\text{rel}} = 3.83\times 10^7\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ s}^{-1}$** ($\Phi_{\rm hi,rel} = 2.46\times 10^4\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ s}^{-1}$).
   - Matches NASA CCMC WSA 5.4 + ENLIL 2.8f (`Jan_Deca_120925_SH_1`: $n_p = 1.11\text{ cm}^{-3}$, $|\mathbf{v}_{\rm SW}| = 408.0\text{ km s}^{-1}$, $\Phi_{p,\text{helio}} = 4.51\times 10^7$, $\Phi_{p,\text{rel}} = 4.07\times 10^7\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ s}^{-1}$), which we showed underpredicts 1 AU spacecraft proton flux by $\sim 2\times$ (`Mod1/Obs = 0.50` at `STEREO-A`, `0.56` at `Wind`).
2. **Model 2 (`model2_wsa_cal`, 1 AU Momentum-Flux Calibrated WSA 5.4)**:
   - **Accepted EPIC-pn GTIs (`21.36 ks`)**: $n_p = 1.95\text{ cm}^{-3}$, $|\mathbf{v}_{\rm SW}| = 452.1\text{ km s}^{-1}$ ($v_{\rm rel} = 414.1\text{ km s}^{-1}$), $\Phi_{p,\text{helio}} = 8.83\times 10^7\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ s}^{-1}$, **comet-frame incident flux $\Phi_{p,\text{rel}} = 8.09\times 10^7\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ s}^{-1}$** ($\Phi_{\rm hi,rel} = 5.66\times 10^4\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ s}^{-1}$).
   - **PN Frame Window (`Dec 3 12:04–Dec 4 10:12 UTC`)**: Mean $\Phi_{p,\text{rel}} = 8.51\times 10^7$, median $8.62\times 10^7\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ s}^{-1}$.
   - Resolves the apparent $1.5\times\text{--}2\times$ offset between CCMC ENLIL and the preprint's ballistic `STEREO-A`/`Wind`/`ACE` extrapolations (`6.95e7–7.51e7 cm^-2 s^-1` median).
3. **Model 3 (`model3_assimilated` & `res_fine_224x48x240`, Multi-Spacecraft Data-Assimilated 3D MHD)**:
   - Captures the exact phase and amplitude of the Nov 28–29 `STEREO-A` CIR (`Mod3/Obs = 1.04` at `STEREO-A`, `1.03` at `Wind`, and out-of-sample `Wind` holdout `1.032` with speed $r = 0.728$).
   - Predicts that the trailing slope of the compressed CIR stream interface sweeps across 3I/ATLAS during `2025-12-03 12:04` – `2025-12-04 04:00 UTC` (coinciding with the initial $4.28\text{ ct s}^{-1}$ peak in the EPIC-pn X-ray lightcurve) before relaxing into the fast coronal-hole stream ($\Phi_{p,\text{rel}} \approx 5.2\times 10^7\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ s}^{-1}$ by `Dec 4 10:12 UTC`).
   - **Fine Grid (`224x48x240`, $1.5^\circ$) Summary**:
     - **Accepted EPIC-pn GTIs (`21.36 ks`)**: Mean $n_p = 4.06\text{ cm}^{-3}$ (median $4.26$), $|\mathbf{v}_{\rm SW}| = 594.7\text{ km s}^{-1}$, $v_{\rm rel} = 551.5\text{ km s}^{-1}$, $\Phi_{p,\text{helio}} = 2.278\times 10^8\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ s}^{-1}$, **comet-frame incident flux $\Phi_{p,\text{rel}} = 2.104\times 10^8\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ s}^{-1}$** (median $2.264\times 10^8\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ s}^{-1}$, $\Phi_{\rm hi,rel} = 1.353\times 10^5\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ s}^{-1}$).
     - **PN Frame Window (`Dec 3 12:04–Dec 4 10:12 UTC`)**: Mean $\Phi_{p,\text{rel}} = 1.713\times 10^8$, **median $1.459\times 10^8\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ s}^{-1}$**.
     - **All-Pointing Window (`Dec 3 12:38–Dec 4 17:22 UTC`)**: Mean $\Phi_{p,\text{rel}} = 1.376\times 10^8$, **median $9.425\times 10^7\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ s}^{-1}$**.

## 3. Convergence & Physical Sensitivity Highlights
- **Spatial Grid Convergence**: Relative to Fine `224x48x240` ($1.5^\circ$), Medium `120x24x120` ($3.0^\circ$) differs by **`-0.60%`** and Baseline `160x32x180` ($2.0^\circ$) differs by **`+2.14%`** in PN-GTI mean incident flux.
- **Temporal Step Size (CFL)**: Halving CFL (`0.175` vs. `0.35`) changes PN-GTI mean incident flux by **`+0.30%`**.
